annotations.title: Take-home pay by country: UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Spain, Portugal, UK, US, Canada, India (2026)

description: Net (take-home) pay for the same gross annual salary in nine countries under 2026 rules, for a single employee with no children: UAE, Saudi Arabia and Qatar (no income tax for expatriates), Spain (normal regime and the 24% Beckham Law regime), Portugal, United Kingdom (England), United States (federal, no state tax), Canada (Ontario) and India (new regime). Returns net pay a year and a month in the salary currency and in local currency, and the share lost to tax and social security, sorted from highest net. Same engine as https://borbur.net/tools/take-home-pay-by-country/ (ECB rates of FX date). Source: https://borbur.net/tools/take-home-pay-by-country/

currency.description: Currency of the salary. Default EUR
